|icon = Tw3 icon gwent melee skellige.png}}'''Hemdall''' is a [[Gwent close combat cards|close combat]] [[gwent]] [[Gwent hero cards|hero]] card in the {{BaW}} and part of the [[Skellige Gwent deck|Skellige deck]]. Hemdall is spawned if Kambi was placed down in the previous round and taken off the board.
==Tips==
*It is possible to have more than one of these cards in play. This usually happens if your opponent plays [[Villentretenmerth (gwent card)]] after using a [[Gwent medic cards|medic]] to revive your [[Kambi (gwent card)]]. Since Hemdall is a hero card the scorch effect ignores it and passes on to the strongest non-hero unit card, so if Kambi is the only such card in play in the close combat row it will be the one that gets destroyed thus summoning a 2nd Hemdall.
**Theoretically it is possible to have up to 6 of these cards in play by getting Kambi revived and scorched repeatedly, however chances of that happening are astronomical.
**With {{Patch|game=3|patch=4.0}} installed it is no longer possible to have more than 1 Hemdall in play, however, it's still possible to summon him again during another round by reviving Kambi.
